# GitHub Copilot Instructions

AGENTS.md is the binding delivery, scope, evidence, repository-safety, and
usage contract. docs/AGENT_OPERATING_MODEL.md is the single procedural
runbook. Follow both before repository writes; do not duplicate their command
blocks or policy here.

Read only the task-relevant authority named by AGENTS.md. For rider-visible
wording, use the relevant section of docs/design/LANGUAGE_SPEC.md and the
surface TRUTHS document; load protocol, economy, or identity sources only when
the proposed change touches those meanings.

Ship the admitted observable outcome, preserve exact direct-JSONL Beads state,
scale verification and review to risk, distinguish local/deployed/physical
evidence, and keep output compact. Routine edits do not need reviewer swarms or
full-repository preflights.
